title: Blender core planning human evaluation
description: A collecting, cross-goal suite for judging semantic planning, capability honesty, teachable guidance, and eventual Blender outcomes without numeric scoring or provider ranking.

criteria.title: Goal decomposition
criteria.question: Does the plan decompose the requested object and workflow into the necessary, correctly ordered parts without treating the reference plan as the only valid answer?
criteria.guidance: Judge the user's requested components and phases. A structurally valid tree can still fail if it omits or invents semantic requirements.

criteria.title: Capability honesty
criteria.question: Does the plan use only catalog actions for supported work and clearly expose unsupported work instead of inventing an action?
criteria.guidance: Capability coverage proves traceability only. Check that unsupported sculpting, simulation, modifiers, or arbitrary code are represented honestly as manual or unavailable work.

criteria.title: Parameter semantic fit
criteria.question: Are geometry, placement, material, camera, lighting, animation, and output parameters plausible for this particular goal?
criteria.guidance: Do not infer quality from Schema validity. Inspect proportions, spatial relationships, surface values, dependency order, and requested output details.

criteria.title: Teaching clarity
criteria.question: Would the ordered titles, intents, explanations, anchors, and observations help a beginner understand what Blender operation is happening and why?
criteria.guidance: Prefer concrete explanations connected to visible host controls and outcomes; generic filler or duplicated text does not meet this criterion.

criteria.title: Host execution outcome
criteria.question: After explicit approval and execution, did the host create the intended owned resources, satisfy observations, and preserve safe Back compensation?
criteria.guidance: Provider generation alone cannot establish this. Mark unable_to_judge unless execution events and host evidence are attached.

criteria.title: Visual alignment
criteria.question: Does the rendered artifact visibly align with the requested subject, composition, materials, and motion at the expected frame?
criteria.guidance: A successful action or PNG file is not a visual-quality judgment. Mark unable_to_judge when no content-hashed rendered artifact is available.

requirements.statement: Create a recognizable snowman with three snow body spheres, eyes, a carrot nose, buttons, arms, and a ground plane.
Use visibly distinct snow, coal, carrot, wood, and ground materials with plausible roughness and metallic values.
Create supported rigid armature motion with explicit poses at frames 1, 20, and 40.
Prepare a controlled render scene and render a PNG preview at frame 20.

request.goal: 创建一个完整的雪人，使用基础体、不同材质和刚性骨骼动画，并在第20帧渲染PNG预览；每一步要适合初学者理解。

requirements.statement: Create a friendly stylized robot with a body, head, two arms, two eyes, and an antenna from supported primitives.
Use a metallic shell and a clearly contrasting accent material.
Do not add animation because the requested deliverable is a still preview.
Render a controlled PNG still preview.

request.goal: Create a friendly stylized robot from supported primitives, use a metallic shell and bright accents, and render a PNG still preview without animation.

requirements.statement: Create a toy rocket silhouette with a cylindrical body, conical nose, side fins represented by supported primitives, and a window.
Use a playful high-contrast palette with a moderately glossy body.
Place the rocket on a ground plane and render a readable PNG preview.

request.goal: Create a colorful toy rocket from supported spheres, cones, cylinders, and a ground plane, then render a clear PNG product preview.

requirements.statement: Create a stable pole, housing, and three vertically ordered signal lights.
The top, middle, and bottom lenses must read as red, amber, and green respectively.
Render a view where all three lenses and the support structure are visible.

request.goal: 用支持的基础体制作一个红黄绿纵向排列的交通信号灯，包括底座、立杆和外壳，并渲染清晰PNG预览。

requirements.statement: Create a visibly balanced stack of at least four differently sized stones using supported geometry.
Use high material roughness so the stones do not look metallic or polished.
Do not claim to sculpt irregular rock topology because sculpting and displacement are absent from the catalog.

request.goal: 创建一个由至少四块不同大小石头组成的平衡石堆，材质要明显粗糙；如果目录无法雕刻不规则表面，要明确说明限制并给出可执行近似方案。

requirements.statement: Recognize that the user requested a cloth flag with wind-driven deformation.
Do not invent cloth, wind, modifier, arbitrary Python, or mesh-editing actions that are absent from the catalog.
Offer only an honest supported subset or clearly labeled manual steps while preserving approval boundaries.

request.goal: Create a cloth flag that deforms naturally in wind, animate the simulation, and render it; clearly identify anything the published action catalog cannot execute.

cases.title: Local snow material roughness revision

requirements.statement: Change only the referenced snow material subtree and preserve the rest of the complete plan.
Increase the snow body's visible roughness while keeping it non-metallic and white.
Do not execute, accept, or modify the Blender scene during generation.

cases.revisionMessage: 让雪人身体的雪材质更粗糙一些，但不要改变颜色、金属度、模型结构、动画、灯光、相机或渲染输出。

dataHandling.warning: This suite contains authored test goals only. Captured runs and annotations require their own data review and may not be used for training.
